prompt_md: Four people cross a bridge at night, at most two at a time, carrying their one torch. They take 1, 2, 5 and 10 minutes; pairs walk at the slower pace. Fewest minutes?
prompt_short: Bridge, one torch, crossing times 1, 2, 5, 10 min. Fewest minutes?
hint_md: Let the two slowest cross together.
explain_intuition_md: The obvious plan has the fastest person escort everyone and run the torch back, which takes 19 minutes. The trick is to send the 5 and the 10 across together so their slow times overlap, with the 1 and 2 doing the torch runs.
explain_math_md: 1 and 2 cross ($2$), 1 returns ($1$), 5 and 10 cross ($10$), 2 returns ($2$), 1 and 2 cross ($2$): $$2 + 1 + 10 + 2 + 2 = 17$$
